method.load: closed-loop, one outstanding request per worker
method.prompt: Output the integers from 1 to 20, separated by single spaces. Output only the integers, with no explanation.
method.quality_rule: finished stop + DONE + usage + exact whitespace-separated integers 1..20
method.ttft_definition: request start to first nonempty delta.content; role/empty/reasoning events excluded
method.tps_definition: reported usage for protocol-success requests / phase elapsed including drain
method.phase_stop: any failed quality check stops new issuance; outstanding calls finish
method.upstream_max_tokens_note: Codex adapter does not forward max_output_tokens; requested max_tokens is not an enforced upstream generation cap.

rate_rounding_review.rule: All QPS/TPS use recorded elapsed_seconds (6 decimals) as authoritative denominator, rates rounded to 4 decimals. Per-request records and Token counts unchanged.
